GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (30 Jun 46) GS
(SCAPIN-1047)
APO 500
30 June 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Temporary Retention of Public Official under SCAPIN 550 - Tadaharu Mukai.
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. No. 3067 (PP), dated 24 June 1946, subject: "Retention of Tadaharu Mukai."
2. The request contained in reference C.L.O. for the temporary retention of Tadaharu Mukai in office for a period of not exceeding two weeks from 24 June 1946 is approved. At the expiration of the stated period he will be removed from public office and excluded from government service as an undesirable person under the terms of SCAPIN 550.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
